title: 29 open items: a proposed order, and the first one decides how the rest get written down
detail: 29 items are open (17 decisions, 21 for Dinis, 20 carried over). No decision taken in a call has been recorded in four stand-ups. Proposed order: (1) WS-107, who records the decisions (Vicky chose option 2: team-collaboration drafts from the transcript, the chair confirms in one line); (2) what has a date this week: the merch collection on Monday 9 Nov and its fallback (WS-48), the newsroom decisions (WS-14); (3) each person names one or two of the 32 Dinis issues without an owner that they would take (from this morning's note in WS-97); (4) the rest of the decisions, oldest first. WS-25 still has no options or recommendation; Nimay's five are the input. Whatever is decided, say it out loud as 'decided: <item>: <words>' so the transcript carries it.

closed.why: A proposed order for the 4 November 13:00, which has passed. Each later stand-up gets its own order, and Dinis's cockpit (/people/dinis/) now ranks his decisions at every release.
